Programming Projects Catalogue

A collection of web projects and a full OS simulator I built from Scratch (literally). Everything here was originally coded in Scratch, then compiled to JavaScript using TurboWarp Packager (How?) to ensure high-performance gameplay. Because these are hosted as single index.html files on GitHub Pages, and also as Windows, MacOS, Linux Electron/WKWEbView in GitHub Releases, you can download that file and run every project offline with zero dependencies! Dates in brackets indicate their original Scratch release. If you are still not satisfied, check out my Scratch account for a bunch of other fun projects too!


The Haunted House (May 2022) (mobile-friendly)



A raycasted first-person arcade-style game of stealth where you're trapped inside a mansion infested with scary monsters! Navigate the haunted house and collect as much candy as you can, while trying to survive as long as possible for the highest score possible!

🏆 Most popular - Scratch community's favourite with 946 views, 35 ❤️,26 ⭐, 7 Remixes, and 47 Comments.

Non-gamer's choice: iush (Aug 2026)



A simulation of the Terminal! Standing for Interactive User Shell, iush is a fully functional virtual command-line environment, featuring custom string parsing, chainable terminal commands, and built-in apps: Notepad, Paint, Regedit, and Domemory - a spaced repetition tool powered by a modified pre-trained SuperMemo-5 algorithm to retain lots of information quickly!

Check out the GitHub repository for full system documentation, command lists, and some fun things you can do inside iush.

Initialize iush now!
